description: fedramp_20x_ksi CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that fedramp_20x_ksi is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (compliance_core) plus fedramp_20x_ksi itself; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds fedramp_20x_ksi (seed-only, offline). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/tap-plugin-fedramp-20x-ksi@v0.3.1#ci' --dev-plugins fedramp_20x_ksi

plugins.note: Declared in depends_on. Pinned at v0.3.0, the release current on 2026-09-09 (renamed edges CITES_COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE / CARRIES_COMPLIANCE_FINDING, Issue# 6 - tap-plugin-fedramp-20x-ksi). Public repo, no credential (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-secret-5).

Self, pinned like any app-of-apps record — the CONSUMER (plugin-ci boot-and-test, or `spawn --dev-plugins fedramp_20x_ksi`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4). Booting this record unflipped runs the pinned revision.

steps.note: Own GRIFT: seeding it proves the bundle parses and its panel types resolve against a real registry.
